# lightweight-charts-drawing

This directory is a vendored and modified copy of
[`deepentropy/lightweight-charts-drawing`](https://github.com/deepentropy/lightweight-charts-drawing),
version 0.1.1, retrieved on 13 August 2026.

The upstream `package.json` and README declare the project to be licensed under
the MIT License. KwantDesk vendors the source so interaction, persistence,
accessibility, and rendering fixes can be reviewed and shipped with the product.

KwantDesk-specific changes are maintained in this directory and in the adapter
at `src/lib/professionalDrawingEngine.ts`.
